acceptance.given: A Package A change set is evaluated against the frozen scope boundary and the named knowledge, Skill-input, test-case, workflow, and app-server/SDK areas are present as repository paths or declared authorities.

oracle.expected: The scope-boundary check reports that none of the named out-of-scope areas are included in the Package A change set, and the evaluated change manifest contains no writes to those areas.
forbidden: Any Package A change targets knowledge publication or Skill-input authority/generation stores.
Any Package A change targets 7-31, TC-D2--TC-D6, BMAD/VDD knowledge-query behavior, S1/S2/S3, or app-server/SDK.
oracle.observable: A deterministic scope-boundary validation artifact lists the evaluated change paths and records exclusion of every named forbidden area.

acceptance.then: The validator emits a passing boundary result only when all named forbidden areas are absent from the evaluated Package A change paths; otherwise it emits a boundary violation.
acceptance.when: During Package A validation, after the candidate change paths are collected and before implementation acceptance is concluded.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the scope-boundary validator against a change manifest containing at least one path under a named forbidden knowledge, Skill-input, test-case, workflow, or app-server/SDK area; the validator must fail with an observable boundary-violation diagnostic.

affected_subjects: Knowledge publication, Skill-input authority/generation stores, 7-31, TC-D2--TC-D6, BMAD/VDD knowledge-query behavior, S1/S2/S3, and app-server/SDK exclusions
slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or maintain deterministic validation evidence that Package A change paths exclude every named out-of-scope authority and runtime area.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No production or schema state changes; revert only the boundary-check test adjustment if needed.

slice_hint.state_transition: Candidate Package A change paths are evaluated and either remain outside the named forbidden areas or transition to a deterministic boundary-violation result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The scope-boundary validation command completes and its structured result demonstrates that all named forbidden areas are excluded from the Package A change set.
